//: Standalone type-check for @corkboards/core. Web and mobile each pull core in through their own tsconfig (web `include`s ../core/src; mobile resolves @core/* via paths), so core errors do surface there — but under WEB's settings, which are the loosest of the three (strict:false, noImplicitAny:false). Mobile compiles with strict:true, so core must satisfy strict regardless; checking it here means a violation is caught in core rather than showing up as a confusing error inside the mobile app.
